trends.name: A portable layer emerges for agent skills and runners
trends.summary: Skill libraries, memory layers and runner routing tools are increasing across developer communities, making agent workflow portability a practical need.
trends.attention_driver: Cross-agent skill libraries, replaceable runners and persistent memory tools are appearing in rapid succession, as developers assemble reusable execution units.

evidence.quote: Agent frameworks for developers are still at an early stage
evidence.claim: Developer discussions show that agent frameworks remain at an early stage of formation.

evidence.quote: Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini CLI
evidence.claim: Community tools already offer skill and plugin marketplaces for use across multiple coding agents.

evidence.quote: Open-source unified interface for agent harnesses.
evidence.claim: New tools are trying to host different agent runners through a unified interface.

trends.so_what: Design skills, prompts, tool permissions and session state as versionable assets to avoid tying them to one runner. Multi-agent features should first account for invocation costs, failure retries and execution evidence, otherwise scaling will amplify invisible costs.

trends.name: Rare book training data dispute expands the scope of provenance governance
trends.summary: Reporting traced rare books to an Amazon AI training facility, raising discussion of training data provenance, cultural asset disposal and copyright liability.
trends.attention_driver: Physical rare books were traced to an AI training facility, drawing attention to the traceability of training data provenance.

evidence.quote: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility
evidence.claim: Independent reporting relayed findings that rare books were traced to an Amazon AI training facility.

evidence.quote: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility
evidence.claim: 404 Media's original report is the direct source for the incident.

evidence.quote: Rare books are incredibly valuable for training LLMs, since these models have already trained on whatever's available online.
evidence.claim: Media outlets linked the training value of rare texts to the depletion of online data.

trends.so_what: Data governance cannot record only permissions for web scraping. Proof of provenance for procurement, donations and physical materials may also affect enterprise customer trust. Products handling high-risk content should provide auditable data provenance documentation and deletion and disposal paths.

trends.name: AI factory expansion brings energy and capacity into product planning
trends.summary: OpenAI joined PORTS-Pike, while NVIDIA emphasized the resource mix of AI factories. Power supply and long-term capacity reservations are becoming external variables in product expansion.
trends.attention_driver: Compute campuses, energy and chip supply are tied together as direct constraints on frontier model expansion.

evidence.quote: OpenAI joins PORTS-Pike project, expanding community investment and supporting thousands of Southern Ohio jobs
evidence.claim: OpenAI has announced that it joined the PORTS-Pike project.

evidence.quote: AI factories require a full stack of critical resources: advanced chips, packaging, memory,
evidence.claim: NVIDIA describes AI factories as infrastructure made up of resources including chips, packaging and memory.

evidence.quote: 初始部署预计提供4.25吉瓦AI工厂容量
evidence.claim: Jensen Huang's public post provided the market narrative around the scale of OpenAI-related AI factory deployments.

trends.so_what: When planning high-concurrency or long-running agents, include capacity, latency and regional availability in the product roadmap rather than estimating only by model unit price. Reserve model fallback and task queuing strategies for supply fluctuations.

watch_list.name: SpaceX completes acquisition of Cursor
watch_list.summary: Cursor has been integrated into SpaceX. Expectations for competition in coding agents now cover model capabilities, compute costs and distribution channels.
watch_list.attention_driver: A coding agent company has been formally integrated into SpaceX, raising expectations for integration across model compute, developer tools and end products.

evidence.quote: Cursor 已被 SpaceX 正式收购，完成自 4 月启动的收购流程。
evidence.claim: Cursor's announcement states that it has been formally acquired by SpaceX.

evidence.quote: AI coding startup Cursor is now officially a part of SpaceX.
evidence.claim: TechCrunch also reported that SpaceX completed its acquisition of Cursor.

watch_list.so_what: Teams relying on a single coding agent vendor should examine the migration costs of models, code hosting and workflow data. Product differentiation will concentrate more on proprietary context, compute pricing and team collaboration entry points, rather than completion quality alone.

insights.text: A portable layer is beginning to take shape: skill libraries and runner interfaces are appearing together, so agent products need to separate workflow assets from execution engines by design
Supply constraints enter experience design: latency and queuing for long-running tasks need to be handled as product capabilities rather than back-end operations issues
More MCP integration signals: 5 new signals point to containerized operation and tool integration, and interoperability merits continued tracking
